Apply patches to freshly cleaned under-eye area.
Smooth out patches to ensure hydrogel sheet makes good contact with skin.
Relax and wear patches for 15 minutes, then discard.
Gently pat any remaining serum into skin.
Follow up with usual skin care regimen.
Precautions: Do not reuse patches. For external use only. Effectiveness may vary per skin type. Stop use immediately and consult a physician if problems occur after use. Keep out of reach of children.
